verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance platform covering sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, case management, payment screening and transaction monitoring. It is not a payment gateway or card authorization service. Routing European card traffic through SCA, triggering 3DS and requesting exemptions is a payment-authentication function outside this product category. Its transaction monitoring is AML risk screening, not 3DS or exemption decisioning, and nothing in the pack shows it ships SCA capabilities.
